board: A Tasmota plug with a power meter, such as the Sonoff S31
result: See your Tasmota plug's power readings on your dashboard, with their history, and get an alert when the power passes a limit. Email is optional.
firstMessage: It sends its first report a few seconds after you paste the line, then one a minute.

routine.name: Tasmota: email when the power passes a limit

connect.label: Tasmota console
connect.text: Backlog3 Rule3 ON Tele-ENERGY#Power DO _WebQuery http://{host}/ingest/{id} POST [X-Chirp-Token:{code}|X-Chirp-Claim:{code}] {{"Power":"%value%"}} ENDON; Rule3 1; TelePeriod 60

steps.title: Check that Rule3 is empty, then paste this line
steps.text: Backlog3 Rule3 ON Tele-ENERGY#Power DO _WebQuery http://{host}/ingest/{id} POST [X-Chirp-Token:{code}|X-Chirp-Claim:{code}] {{"Power":"%value%"}} ENDON; Rule3 1; TelePeriod 60
